decision: The upstream patch narrows current MDC radio state/icon/ripple selectors. The owned Material-16 legacy radio CSS uses historical `.mat-radio-*` roles. The package also exports a `radio-theme` historical M2 module, but radio is absent from the thirteen-family current-companion roster and its implementation does not call `mat.radio-overrides`; the separate `legacy-radio-theme` is the owned legacy theme. Do not port modern MDC selectors into legacy radio CSS. No supported current-peer M2 radio bridge is claimed.
peer_coexistence_unresolved: No thirteen-family current-peer radio bridge is declared; the exported radio-theme is a historical M2 Sass API and is not a mat.radio-overrides bridge. Do not treat unsupported theme use on current peer as an outstanding package qualification obligation.
